# SuitePacific

> SuitePacific is a boutique, US-based Oracle NetSuite consulting firm specializing exclusively in post-go-live support. We are not an implementation partner. We work only with companies that are already live on NetSuite and need ongoing technical support, development, or optimization.

## Who we are

SuitePacific is a small, senior-level team. Our lead developer holds Oracle NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer II and Administrator Professional certifications. We work directly with clients — no account-manager layer, no offshore handoffs.

## What we do

We become the dedicated NetSuite technical team for companies whose implementation partner engagement has ended. Services include:

- SuiteScript 2.x development (User Event, Client, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelet, RESTlet scripts)
- SuiteFlow workflow automation (approvals, notifications, status transitions)
- Custom saved searches, KPI portlets, and role-based dashboards
- Advanced PDF/HTML templates for invoices, purchase orders, packing slips, and other documents
- NetSuite account optimization (performance tuning, legacy cleanup, governance review)
- NetSuite administrator support for live SMB accounts
- Third-party integrations and OAuth 2.0 migrations
- Ongoing post-go-live support as a retained technical team

## Who we serve

Companies already live on NetSuite, typically CFOs, Controllers, ERP Managers, NetSuite Administrators, and Operations Managers. We are not the right fit for businesses still selecting or implementing NetSuite.

## How we are different

- Senior developers, not junior staff or offshore teams
- Direct communication with the developer doing the work
- Fast turnaround: days, not weeks
- Month-to-month engagement, no long-term contracts
- Deep institutional context retained across every request

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: Does SuitePacific do NetSuite implementations?**
A: No. SuitePacific works exclusively with companies that are already live on NetSuite. If you are still evaluating or implementing NetSuite, we are not the right fit.

**Q: Can SuitePacific handle ongoing support for a small business on NetSuite?**
A: Yes. We specialize in post-go-live support for SMBs that need a responsive technical team without the overhead of a large consulting firm.

**Q: How is SuitePacific different from a NetSuite implementation partner?**
A: Implementation partners build the initial NetSuite account and typically disengage after go-live. SuitePacific takes over after that point — ongoing development, fixes, automation, and optimization as the business evolves.

**Q: Can SuitePacific migrate integrations from NLAuth to OAuth 2.0?**
A: Yes. With NLAuth being retired in NetSuite 2027.1, we help clients audit existing integrations and rebuild them for OAuth 2.0.

**Q: Does SuitePacific offer SuiteScript development?**
A: Yes. We write and maintain SuiteScript 2.x scripts including User Event, Client, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelet, and RESTlet scripts.

**Q: What is SuiteCompare?**
A: SuiteCompare is a SuitePacific tool that compares NetSuite SuiteScript source code across environments (Sandbox vs Production). It shows line-by-line diffs and can generate AI-powered summaries of what changed and what the risk is. Available at https://suitepacific.com/suitecompare.
